parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: The lid is the upper cover of the suitcase, made of durable polycarbonate material. It forms one half of the suitcase shell.
parts.Functional_description: It protects the contents of the suitcase and closes securely against the base body using hinges and latches.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the hinge axis to open or close the suitcase.

parts.name: Handle
parts.Basic_description: The handle is a small, rigid component located on the top of the suitcase, made of ABS plastic for strength and comfort.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to carry or lift the suitcase easily.
parts.Movement_description: It may pivot slightly or retract depending on the design, but generally remains fixed during use.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main compartment of the suitcase, made of polycarbonate for impact resistance and durability.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the majority of the suitcase’s storage space and supports the lid when closed.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the structural foundation of the suitcase.
